::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1880?][^1]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29: Author Files Wood-Yonge:
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1478.qmd)

I hardly know how to answer you, for the having had the [Angel of Viareggio](other_books/otherbook_917.qmd) is first a reason for not being able to take another story in the same line. I think however that [Griffith and Farran](organizations/other_233.qmd)- or [Cassell](organizations/other_216.qmd) or[Routledge](organizations/other_258.qmd)- or [Aunt Judy’s Magazine](organizations/other_54.qmd) would be glad of a child’s story with a little foreign colouring.

I believe Signora [Linda Villari](people/person_1444.qmd) is English not American, but I do not know

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Since this letter refers to Linda Villari's 'The Angel of Viareggio', which was published in *MP* in the first half of 1880, it seems probable that it dates from shortly after the publication of that story.
